purpose: Record a single self-reported routing sample for the split documentation route and Codex-first opt-in subagent contract against the prior committed APEX series.
method: Fresh-context Codex subagents returned exact unordered skill selections from label-hidden queries. One was assigned the current skill content and one the seven skills at the previous commit. A first current sample exposed bootstrap shadowing and was retained before the trigger clarification and fresh rerun.
notes: Assignment summaries and final responses are retained, and current skill bytes are pinned by SHA-256. The collaboration notifications exposed neither raw assignment tool envelopes, transcripts, nor timing/token metrics. This is not an official skill-creator benchmark and supports only reproducible arithmetic over the stored self-reported selections, not causal performance or variance claims.
